title: Beatrix and the Sigil
author: Ansel Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Amberdale, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
